title: Chapter 114 Return To The Deserted City
content:
Chapter 114 Return To The Deserted City

Death Star Field.

"Boy, do you really want to leave with me?"

A phantom stood aside, quietly looking at the man sitting cross-legged in front of him.

Upon hearing this, Kong slowly opened his eyes.

"Senior, I will only follow one person in my life. I appreciate your kindness."

Kong replied faintly.

Hearing this, the Dark Emperor frowned slightly.

He really liked this kid, and he even planned to train him into his heir in his heart.

The only thing that is bad is that it is too stubborn.

This kid doesn't have oil or salt.

"Boy, do you know how powerful my power is? I don't even look down on this small and broken place now."

"You stay here. Although you have learned my true teachings, you still don't know how much you need to use if you want to continue moving up."

As he said that, the Dark Emperor stood with his hands behind his back, and said arrogantly: "If I follow me, I will be able to take you ascend now."

"Can the person you follow do it?"

Hearing this, Kong's expression did not change, and he was still expressionless.

"able."

In his heart, there is nothing in this world that cannot be done by that person.

Hearing this, the Dark Emperor choked when he said something.

Yes, that's a big deal!

"Tell me, where is the person you are talking about? I want to see who can brainwash you so much?"

After a long time, the Dark Emperor's true body left the Death Star Realm.

Now he has been able to go back long ago, but he has met Kong, so he stayed for the time being to teach Kong's own true learning.

I just hope that if something happens to me one day, I will be able to replace myself and take care of the forces I have left behind.

In his eyes, he has this potential.

And now, someone actually fooled Huo first, which made him a little angry.

He didn't believe that there was still someone in the lower world who was even more awesome than him.

Of course, except for Yan Lingyun.

Immediately, the Dark Emperor rushed towards the direction of the Xuanling Star Domain in anger.

I don't know how long it took.

Xuanling Star Domain, Desert City.

At this moment, the Huangcheng has become the center of the Xuanling Star Domain, and there are almost countless practitioners coming here every day.

Most of them came to pay homage to the great men who saved the entire Xuanling Star Domain.

The Lord of the Huangcheng City, Lu Daosheng.

"Viagra, the city lord doesn't know where he went."

In a tavern, An Xing lay halfway on a chair and said quietly with his feet on the table.

On the side, Awei took a sip of wine and said slowly, "If you are fine, I will go back."

Hearing this, An Xing chuckled and said, "Go back? Why are you going back? Find your little wife?"

As the leader of the Gen Organization, An Xing naturally knew everything about Awei finding a woman from the Elf clan as his wife.

An Xing did not make any comments on this matter, just as Ah Wei did not laugh at him.

When Awei heard An Xing's words, for some reason, his face turned slightly red. He emptied the wine glass in his hand in one mouthful, and then got up and left.

Seeing this, An Xing quickly stopped Awei.

"Hey hey hey, don't leave, listen to me."

Awei sat down in anger and looked at An Xing and said indifferently, "Hurry up and say, I have something to do at home."

Upon hearing this, An Xing was not keeping a secret, and then whispered: "Viagra, I have something to do recently. I want to go back to the world of all spirits. You can watch it here."

Hearing this, Awei frowned slightly.

"What can you do in the world of all spirits?"

"Well, Viagra, don't worry about this."

After a moment of silence, Awei nodded slightly, "Yes, but,"

"But what?"

When An Xing saw Awei agreeing, his expression lit up and asked quickly.

Awei said indifferently: "Send me some good secret guards."

Secret Guard, a group of experts in the root organization who are in secret, are often used to assassinate and protect.

Awei asked for several secret guards, and his intentions were very obvious.

An Xing also knew what Awei was thinking, so he nodded and said, "Okay, the deal is done."

At this time, a figure slowly came from afar towards here.

"Well, Brother Gu, what happened? He was so frowning."

Seeing Gu Chen's face was a little haggard, An Xing said in confusion.

Awei was also a little confused.

Could it be that something happened in the city lord's mansion?

It should be unlikely.

But they still had some vague guesses when they received an order from Lu Daosheng not long ago and a large number of people suddenly moved out of the City Lord's Mansion.

Gu Chen sighed and shook his head slowly, "It's not a big deal. Even Xiaoxue kept crying, and she didn't say anything if she asked her."

Hearing this, An Xing smiled and said, "It must be because the city lord didn't take her with him when he went out."

Awei, who was beside him, frowned.

In the entire wasteland city, except Lu Xue, he was the one who has been with Lu Daosheng for the longest time.

He basically watched Lu Xue grow up. He knew Lu Xue's personality and kept crying. It was obviously not just because the city lord left.

At the same time, outside the deserted city.

"Damn it, is that a coincidence?"

The Dark Emperor came to the front of the Huangcheng City and looked at the giant city in front of him, slowly leaving a drop of cold sweat.

After all the calculations, I didn't expect that the person Kong mentioned was the same person he had paid attention to before.

No wonder Sho was so loyal.

Not long ago, after easily taking the attack from the Immortal Saint Realm with one blow, he had already noticed Lu Daosheng.

Not an ordinary person.

Sure enough, this guy is Miss Yan’s man.

This shocked him even more. Miss Yan was such a person. How could he win her heart without some ability?

But the most outrageous thing was that he never expected that Lu Daosheng would become an immortal on the spot. He had never seen such an operation in his life.

He couldn't afford to offend him.

Then, the Dark Emperor was about to turn around and leave, but he hesitated. Would it be impolite to leave like this?

Just as he was silent, two figures suddenly appeared in front of him.

"Second Dark Emperor, what are you doing here?"

The two figures were naturally Lu Daosheng and Yan Lingyun who had just come back from pretending to be powerful.

Looking at the Dark Emperor, Yan Lingyun frowned slightly.

Seeing the two people, the Dark Emperor trembled all over, and hurriedly smiled and said: "Ahaha, you two, what a coincidence, I, I'm fine, I'm just taking a walk."

At this time, Lu Daosheng was also looking at the Dark Emperor in front of him with interest.

He could feel the breath of air on this guy.

But Lu Daosheng didn't point it out, just smiled and said nothing.

Seeing the two holding hands, the Dark Emperor coughed lightly, and then said: "Oh, I remember, I have something to do at home, you two, see you again if we are lucky."

After saying that, the Dark Emperor trembled and left here.

At the original place, Lu Daosheng looked at Yan Lingyun and smiled: "Lingyun, let's go in."

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun nodded.

"Okay."

On the city wall, Huang Shou said respectfully: "Lord City Lord, you are back."

Lu Daosheng nodded, "Huang Shou, thank you for your hard work."

Hearing this, Huang Shou waved his hands repeatedly and said: "Lord City Lord, this is what I should do."

As he said, Huang Shou kept glancing at Yan Lingyun beside Lu Daosheng.

Looking at the two holding hands, Huang Shou was shocked.

This woman is not only powerful, but also so capable that she can even take down a figure like the Lord City Lord.

Huang Shou silently gave Yan Lingyun a thumbs up in his heart.
